title: Crispy Kare Kare with Fried Eggplant
description: A Filipino-inspired dish made with tender eggplant, crispy peanuts, and a rich peanut sauce.
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of peanut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté until fragrant.
Add the cubed eggplant and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of peanut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped peanuts and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the peanut butter, kare kare, salt, and stir until combined.
Add the cooked eggplant to the sauce and stir until coated.
Serve the eggplant with crispy peanuts and a fried eggplant slice on top.
Optional: garnish with chopped green onions or toasted peanuts.
